name: creative-hover-card
title: Creative Hover Card
blurb: Cards with image swaps, text reveals, and color transitions on hover.
description: Grid of three demo cards with creative hover effects: badge color changes, text swaps between states, images fade in/out, and subtle Y-axis translation. Each card has unique styling and behavior.
use_when: Product showcases, feature highlights, or galleries where hover interactions add storytelling.
avoid_when: Touch-only platforms — hover effects are mouse-dependent.
a11y: Text content is readable. Images have alt text. Focus state should mirror hover for keyboard users.
